dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregularly shaped 'C' and 'O' structures clustered on the mid-upper flank; edges exhibit high-frequency jaggedness with sharp transitions from the dark charcoal background to light-grey/white interior perimeters.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, solid light-grey pixel clusters across the mid-dorsal region, with distinct core concentrations lacking internal gradients localized posterior to the pectoral flipper.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent dorsal-lateral 'O' rings form an obtuse triangle, while a secondary linear arrangement of four high-intensity blobs aligns parallel to the dorsal spine.

other_distinctive_markers: Deep transverse integumentary folds/furrows visible across the ventral-lateral neck region; a high-contrast jagged light-intensity marking is present on the distal portion of the hind flipper.
